title: FalsegreenReport
description: Full analysis report produced by one falsegreen-skill invocation over a test file or suite.

findings.description: List of individual findings from the J1-J6 analysis.

summary.description: Aggregate counts for the analyzed file or suite.

tests_reviewed.description: Total number of test functions examined.

clean.description: Number of tests with no findings.

language.description: Primary programming language or test stack of the analyzed file. Matches the per-finding enum.

framework.description: Test framework detected in the file (e.g., pytest, jest, vitest, unittest).

scan_date.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the scan was run.
